errors.evidence: The description states there are five methods, but the legend and plot show six methods (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, ROME).
The description completely omits the 'IKE' data series, which is represented by a red line with triangle markers.
The data on the x-axis ranges from a value slightly greater than 0 (around 4 or 5) to a value past 10^3 (approximately 3000), not from 1 to 1000.
The marker for the FT line is an inverted triangle, not a triangle. The triangle marker corresponds to the IKE method, which was omitted from the description.
The first data points for all lines are not at a co-occurrence number of 1. They are located at a value between 0 and 10^1, closer to 4 or 5.
The last data points for all lines are not at a co-occurrence number of 1000. They are located at a value significantly past the 10^3 tick mark, closer to 3000.
